actions.name: media_play
actions.description: Start or force-resume playback on an MPRIS player (Spotify, mpv, VLC, browser tab, ...); if `uri` is given, opens/loads that media first via OpenUri, then plays. Unlike media_play_pause, this always ends in the playing state rather than toggling.

player.description: MPRIS player: full bus name (org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.spotify) or short name (spotify, firefox). Omit to target the active player: the one playing (ties broken by which stream is actually audible), else the most recently paused; several playing -> ERR_MEDIA_AMBIGUOUS listing them.

uri.description: Optional media URI to open before playing.

player.description: The MPRIS player that was acted on.

actions.name: media_pause
actions.description: Pause playback without changing track or position; always ends paused. Without `player`, pauses every player that is currently playing ("pause the music") and returns them in `players` (use media_play to resume, media_play_pause to toggle).

player.description: MPRIS player: full bus name or short name (spotify, firefox). Omit to act on EVERY currently playing player (no-op when nothing plays).

players.description: The MPRIS players that were acted on (empty when nothing was playing).

actions.name: media_play_pause
actions.description: Toggle playback. With `player`: flips that player between playing and paused and reports the resulting `playing`. Without `player`: if anything is playing, pauses all of it; otherwise resumes the most recently paused player. Prefer media_play / media_pause when the intended end state is known.

player.description: MPRIS player: full bus name (org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.spotify) or short name (spotify, firefox). Omit to target the active player: the one playing (ties broken by which stream is actually audible), else the most recently paused; several playing -> ERR_MEDIA_AMBIGUOUS listing them.
The MPRIS player that was acted on.

players.description: Without `player` and with something playing: every player that was paused.

actions.name: media_next
actions.description: Skip to the next track/item on an MPRIS player's current playlist.

player.description: MPRIS player: full bus name (org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.spotify) or short name (spotify, firefox). Omit to target the active player: the one playing (ties broken by which stream is actually audible), else the most recently paused; several playing -> ERR_MEDIA_AMBIGUOUS listing them.
The MPRIS player that was acted on.

actions.name: media_prev
actions.description: Skip to the previous track/item on an MPRIS player's current playlist.

player.description: MPRIS player: full bus name (org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.spotify) or short name (spotify, firefox). Omit to target the active player: the one playing (ties broken by which stream is actually audible), else the most recently paused; several playing -> ERR_MEDIA_AMBIGUOUS listing them.
The MPRIS player that was acted on.

actions.name: media_stop
actions.description: Stop playback entirely; without `player` stops every player that is currently playing. Unlike media_pause, some players reset or drop the playback position on stop rather than keeping it for resume.

player.description: MPRIS player: full bus name or short name (spotify, firefox). Omit to act on EVERY currently playing player (no-op when nothing plays).

players.description: The MPRIS players that were acted on (empty when nothing was playing).

actions.name: media_seek
actions.description: Jump to an absolute position (`position_ms`, measured from the start of the current track) on an MPRIS player; for a relative jump forward/back from wherever playback is now, use media_seek_relative instead.

position_ms.description: Absolute seek target in milliseconds from the start of the track.

player.description: MPRIS player: full bus name (org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.spotify) or short name (spotify, firefox). Omit to target the active player: the one playing (ties broken by which stream is actually audible), else the most recently paused; several playing -> ERR_MEDIA_AMBIGUOUS listing them.
The MPRIS player that was acted on.

actions.name: media_seek_relative
actions.description: Jump forward or backward by a signed `offset_ms` from the current playback position on an MPRIS player (negative rewinds; result clamps at 0); for a jump to a specific absolute timestamp, use media_seek instead.

offset_ms.description: Signed offset in milliseconds from the current position (negative seeks backward; result clamps at 0).

player.description: MPRIS player: full bus name (org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.spotify) or short name (spotify, firefox). Omit to target the active player: the one playing (ties broken by which stream is actually audible), else the most recently paused; several playing -> ERR_MEDIA_AMBIGUOUS listing them.

position_ms.description: Requested target position in milliseconds after applying the offset.

player.description: The MPRIS player that was acted on.

actions.name: media_volume
actions.description: Set an MPRIS player's volume via `level`, accepted as either a 0.0-1.0 fraction or a 0-100 integer percentage — note the ambiguity: JSON `1` (integer) means 1%, while `1.0` (float) means 100%; send a float for a fraction and an integer for a percentage. This sets the player's own MPRIS volume, which some players (browsers) ignore or only partly honour; media_stream_volume changes the app's audio stream in the system mixer and works for every app.

level.description: Target volume: a 0.0..1.0 fraction or a 0..100 integer percentage.

player.description: MPRIS player: full bus name (org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.spotify) or short name (spotify, firefox). Omit to target the active player: the one playing (ties broken by which stream is actually audible), else the most recently paused; several playing -> ERR_MEDIA_AMBIGUOUS listing them.
The MPRIS player that was acted on.

actions.name: media_status
actions.description: Get full playback state for an MPRIS player in one call: status (Playing/Paused/Stopped), track metadata (title/artist/album/...), volume, position_ms, playback rate, shuffle, and loop_status — use this to check what's playing before deciding to play/pause/skip.

player.description: MPRIS player: full bus name (org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.spotify) or short name (spotify, firefox). Omit to target the active player: the one playing (ties broken by which stream is actually audible), else the most recently paused; several playing -> ERR_MEDIA_AMBIGUOUS listing them.
MPRIS player name queried.

metadata.description: Normalized MPRIS metadata (title, artists, album, length_micros, track_id, art_url).

stream.description: The player's audio streams in the system mixer (id, app, volume, muted, running, sink), null when it has none or audio tools are unavailable.

actions.name: media_list_players
actions.description: List MPRIS player names currently on the session D-Bus (org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.<name>) — use to discover the `player` value for other media_* actions when more than one app is playing audio.

players.description: MPRIS player names (org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.<name>) available on the session bus.

actions.name: media_shuffle
actions.description: Turn shuffle mode on or off (`enabled`, alias `shuffle`) for an MPRIS player.

enabled.description: Enable shuffle (true) or disable (false). Alias `shuffle` also accepted.

player.description: MPRIS player: full bus name (org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.spotify) or short name (spotify, firefox). Omit to target the active player: the one playing (ties broken by which stream is actually audible), else the most recently paused; several playing -> ERR_MEDIA_AMBIGUOUS listing them.
The MPRIS player that was acted on.

actions.name: media_loop
actions.description: Set repeat mode on an MPRIS player: none (stop at end), track (repeat the current track), or playlist (repeat the whole queue).

player.description: MPRIS player: full bus name (org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.spotify) or short name (spotify, firefox). Omit to target the active player: the one playing (ties broken by which stream is actually audible), else the most recently paused; several playing -> ERR_MEDIA_AMBIGUOUS listing them.
The MPRIS player that was acted on.

actions.name: media_raise
actions.description: Bring an MPRIS player's window to the foreground/focus via its Raise method; only changes window focus, not playback.

player.description: MPRIS player: full bus name (org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.spotify) or short name (spotify, firefox). Omit to target the active player: the one playing (ties broken by which stream is actually audible), else the most recently paused; several playing -> ERR_MEDIA_AMBIGUOUS listing them.
The MPRIS player that was acted on.

actions.name: media_quit
actions.description: Quit the MPRIS player application entirely (its Quit method) — unlike media_stop, which only halts playback, this closes the whole app and can lose any unsaved queue/session state in it.

player.description: MPRIS player: full bus name (org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.spotify) or short name (spotify, firefox). Omit to target the active player: the one playing (ties broken by which stream is actually audible), else the most recently paused; several playing -> ERR_MEDIA_AMBIGUOUS listing them.
The MPRIS player that was acted on.

actions.name: media_streams
actions.description: List apps currently producing audio (per-application streams in the PipeWire/PulseAudio mixer) with their volume, mute state, whether they are audible right now, the output device they play on, and the owning MPRIS player; also lists available output devices (`sinks`). Use this to see what is making sound and to find `stream`/`app`/`sink` values for the media_stream_* actions.

app.description: Only streams whose application name or binary contains this (case-insensitive).

items.description: Audio stream: id, app, media_name?, pid?, binary?, volume (0.0-1.0 mixer scale), muted, running, sink? (output device node name), and in media_streams also audible and player? (owning MPRIS player).

actions.name: media_stream_volume
actions.description: Set the mixer volume of one application's audio (e.g. only Firefox or only Spotify quieter) without touching other apps or the master volume; works for any app, including ones whose MPRIS volume is ignored. `level` is a 0.0-1.0 fraction or 0-100 integer percent (integer 1 = 1%, float 1.0 = 100%). Target: `stream` > `app` > `player`; with none of them, the active player's streams (same resolution as media_pause/media_next).

level.description: Target volume: a 0.0..1.0 fraction or a 0..100 integer percentage.

app.description: Case-insensitive substring of the application name or binary ("firefox", "telegram"). Affects every stream of that app.

player.description: MPRIS player (full or short name); its streams are found by process id.

items.description: Audio stream: id, app, media_name?, pid?, binary?, volume (0.0-1.0 mixer scale), muted, running, sink? (output device node name), and in media_streams also audible and player? (owning MPRIS player).

streams.description: The affected streams re-read after the change.

player.description: The MPRIS player that was acted on.

actions.name: media_stream_mute
actions.description: Mute, unmute or toggle one application's audio in the mixer (playback continues silently; use media_pause to actually pause). `mode` is on/off/toggle; toggling an app with several streams (browser tabs) mutes all of them if any is unmuted, else unmutes all. Target: `stream` > `app` > `player`; with none of them, the active player's streams (same resolution as media_pause/media_next).

app.description: Case-insensitive substring of the application name or binary ("firefox", "telegram"). Affects every stream of that app.

player.description: MPRIS player (full or short name); its streams are found by process id.

items.description: Audio stream: id, app, media_name?, pid?, binary?, volume (0.0-1.0 mixer scale), muted, running, sink? (output device node name), and in media_streams also audible and player? (owning MPRIS player).

streams.description: The affected streams re-read after the change.

player.description: The MPRIS player that was acted on.

actions.name: media_stream_move
actions.description: Move one application's audio to another output device (e.g. Spotify to the Bluetooth speaker, Firefox to headphones) without changing the system default output; the choice is remembered for that app by the session manager. `sink` is an id, node name, or unique case-insensitive part of a device name/description from media_streams' `sinks`. Target: `stream` > `app` > `player`; with none of them, the active player's streams (same resolution as media_pause/media_next).

sink.description: Output device: id, node name, or unique part of its name/description.

app.description: Case-insensitive substring of the application name or binary ("firefox", "telegram"). Affects every stream of that app.

player.description: MPRIS player (full or short name); its streams are found by process id.

items.description: Audio stream: id, app, media_name?, pid?, binary?, volume (0.0-1.0 mixer scale), muted, running, sink? (output device node name), and in media_streams also audible and player? (owning MPRIS player).

streams.description: The affected streams re-read after the change.

player.description: The MPRIS player that was acted on.

sink.description: The output device the streams were moved to.
